chunks: So, as We recite it, follow its reading.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to follow the Quran's reading when it is recited?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Qiyamah, this verse highlights the divine method of revelation, where Allah first recites the text to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) before he conveys it to the community. Shia scholarship emphasizes this as a guarantee of the Quran's authenticity and the Prophet's role as the perfect recipient and transmitter of the divine word, reinforcing the importance of attentive listening (istima') as a prerequisite for true understanding and adherence.
